title: An FPRAS for Common Integer Polymatroid Bases with Binary Capacities
summary: We give a fully polynomial randomized approximation scheme for counting common integer bases of two polymatroids with the same total rank, supplied by exact rank-value oracles. The total rank and capacities are encoded in binary, and each integer vector is counted once. On every execution, the number of oracle calls and the bit work outside the oracles are bounded by a fixed polynomial in the ground-set size, the binary input length, the inverse relative-error tolerance, and the logarithm of the inverse failure probability.
